_readme: Metros whose Python score legitimately differs from the workbook's cached
column BG. A ratchet, same discipline as scripts/slug-baseline.json: known
drift passes check:score-parity, NEW drift fails it, and this list only
ever shrinks. Every entry carries the reason it is here, because a baseline
without a reason is a suppressed test.
To clear an entry: open MetroAreas.xlsx, let Excel recalculate, save. BG
catches up and the parity run will print 'RESOLVED, remove from ...'.
Delete the entry then. Do not add an entry without recording why.
